note: A DRAFT written by the model from general knowledge (no web research). Every page is an idea until a person has read it.

pages.title: Home
pages.purpose: Introduce the store, highlight featured fragrances and invite visitors to shop or visit.

pages.title: Shop All Perfumes
pages.purpose: Browse and buy the full range of fragrances with filters for brand, scent family and size.

pages.title: Women's Fragrances
pages.purpose: Showcase perfumes curated for women with notes, sizes and prices.

pages.title: Men's Fragrances
pages.purpose: Showcase colognes and perfumes curated for men with notes, sizes and prices.

pages.title: Unisex Fragrances
pages.purpose: Present gender-neutral scents for anyone to explore.

pages.title: Brands
pages.purpose: List the designer and niche houses the store carries with links to each brand's products.

pages.title: New Arrivals
pages.purpose: Show the latest fragrances that have just come into the store.

pages.title: Best Sellers
pages.purpose: Highlight the most popular perfumes to help hesitant shoppers choose.

pages.title: Gift Sets
pages.purpose: Offer boxed sets and ready-made gift bundles for birthdays and holidays.

pages.title: Gift Cards
pages.purpose: Let visitors buy a gift card for a friend or family member.

pages.title: Samples & Discovery Sets
pages.purpose: Sell small vials and sample sets so customers can try scents before buying a full bottle.

pages.title: Scent Guide
pages.purpose: Explain fragrance families, notes and how to choose a perfume that suits you.

pages.title: Book a Fragrance Consultation
pages.purpose: Let visitors book a one-to-one session with a fragrance advisor in store.

pages.title: About Us
pages.purpose: Tell the story of the store, its values and why it selects its fragrances.

pages.title: Meet the Team
pages.purpose: Introduce the fragrance advisors and staff customers will meet in store.

pages.title: Customer Reviews
pages.purpose: Collect testimonials and ratings from happy customers to build trust.

pages.title: Journal
pages.purpose: Share articles on fragrance trends, layering tips and seasonal picks.

pages.title: Events & Workshops
pages.purpose: Promote in-store launches, scent workshops and tasting-style smelling evenings.

pages.title: Personalization & Engraving
pages.purpose: Describe custom engraving and personalized gift packaging options.

pages.title: Perfume Care & Storage
pages.purpose: Give advice on making fragrances last and storing bottles properly.

pages.title: Shipping & Returns
pages.purpose: Explain delivery options, costs, timelines and the returns policy.

pages.title: FAQ
pages.purpose: Answer common questions about authenticity, ingredients, orders and sizes.

pages.title: Visit the Store
pages.purpose: Show the shop address, opening hours, map and parking or transit directions.

pages.title: Contact
pages.purpose: Give phone, email, address and a form for questions and special requests.
